review_note: Read the test and helpers. Independent base-R dense Laplace oracle on hand-built kernels: Henderson tabular A from an inbred pedigree (Ainv by solve, and pedigree compared against the hand A), and a hand relmat kernel (Q by solve). The iid member has K = I. logLik is within 1e-4 of the oracle for every fit; oracle values agree across providers within 1e-6. Asserted emulated bugs, each moving the oracle by more than 0.1: swapped selector coefficients, reversed SD for each field, cov2cor(K), K x 2 and kernel read by position for the animal or relmat field. All 15 linked row_keys are fitted: iid+animal for A, Ainv and pedigree on logit, probit and cloglog (9), and iid+relmat for K and Q on the three links (6). The three logit iid+animal-A and logit iid+relmat-K/Q rows have no parent id, so they are fresh evidence only. Each field is an intercept with sd ~ covariate on its own factor. Hashes match, and the console shows 246 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, exit 0, with no Julia. Does NOT establish: iid+phylo or crossed layouts (other receipt); slope, labelled or correlated blocks; calibration, coverage, SE or recovery; Julia parity; any seed beyond the fixed per-link seeds; kernel-scale sensitivity for the iid member; behaviour away from the fitted optimum.
